target: Prospective valid-control false-block, fairness, precision and sufficiency thresholds

findings.claim: The frozen metadata gives case counts, families and transformations but not an oracle-frozen valid/invalid label, fairness-stratum assignment or denominator map, so false-block, fairness and precision are not yet computable.
findings.recommended_test: DET-FBF-INPUTS: verify every public/sealed case hash maps before any run to one oracle class, zero or more frozen strata, one seed identity and an inclusion/exclusion reason; reject missing, duplicate or post-result mappings.

findings.claim: Candidates cite false-block falsification, but no shared numeric noninferiority, fairness, precision or abstention rule is frozen; comparison after observing results would permit threshold drift.
findings.recommended_test: DET-FBF-FREEZE: canonicalize and hash the evaluator, margins, strata, exclusions and tie/abstention rules before any prototype result; fail on later mutation.

findings.claim: The prospective synthetic benchmark is frozen before prototypes, supplies a retain-scaffold baseline, public and sealed cases, family hashes and benign metamorphic transformations; this supports paired replay once FBF-001 and FBF-002 are resolved.

proposed_rules: Freeze before results: oracle class VALID_CONTROL or INVALID_CONTROL; strata from case-family class and benign transformation; case/seed hashes; exclusions; evaluator hash. Candidate and ARCH-S0 must receive identical cases, seeds, budgets and environment.

Define FB_x=sum(VALID_CONTROL and blocked_by_x)/N_valid. Set delta_v=max(0.05,1/N_valid). A candidate passes only if false-block count_x<=count_S0+1 and the fixed one-sided exact paired noninferiority test at alpha=0.05 rejects FB_x-FB_S0>=delta_v.

For each frozen stratum s, require N_s>=10 and delta_s=max(0.10,1/N_s); require count_x,s<=count_S0,s+1 and the same exact paired test to reject FB_x,s-FB_S0,s>=delta_s. Also require max_s(FB_x,s)-min_s(FB_x,s)<=max_s(FB_S0,s)-min_s(FB_S0,s)+0.10.

Treat every benign metamorphic original/variant pair as a fairness control. A valid original accepted by x but variant blocked by x is a flip; per transformation, candidate flips may not exceed baseline flips by more than one and flip rate may not exceed baseline rate plus max(0.05,1/N_transform).

Define block precision_x=blocked INVALID_CONTROL/(all blocked labeled controls). Require denominator>=10, precision_x>=0.90, precision_x>=precision_S0-0.02 when baseline precision is defined, and one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson lower bound>=0.80. Zero blocks makes precision undefined, not perfect.

Evidence is sufficient only with N_valid>=20 paired eligible controls, N_s>=10 for every reported stratum, N_transform>=10 for every reported transformation, at least 10 blocked labeled controls for precision, complete outputs for baseline and candidate, intact hashes, and no recovery-affected, leaked, censored or post-freeze records.

Rules are lexicographic and noncompensatory: hard safety failures reject first; false-block, every stratum, metamorphic fairness and precision must each pass; effectiveness, cost, aggregate averages or votes cannot offset a failure.

Replay must recompute labels, denominators, paired discordances, exact tests, confidence bounds and reason codes from frozen hashes and produce byte-identical canonical results across at least two clean replays.
abstentions: Abstain on thresholds until FBF-001 and FBF-002 pass.
Abstain for any missing baseline/candidate pair, insufficient denominator, undefined precision, hash mismatch, leakage, censoring, recovery-affected result, changed evaluator or unregistered stratum.
No candidate ranking, architecture selection or performance conclusion is made.
